shared_elements: quadruped with visible head and legs
justification: Both are weathered stone reliefs organised into horizontal registers, with a row of repeated motifs above a band and profile animals below, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a long, shallow, highly finished procession of naturalistic human figures on a flat wall, while B is a narrow free-standing pillar carved with bold, schematic, high-relief creatures — the carving manner, scale and subject matter differ almost completely.
